description_en: Generate a message channel access signature based on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID and agent account name.
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID和坐席账号名称，生成消息通道访问签名
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs generate-websocket-sign --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-0000-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateWebSocketSign

parameters.help_en: Unique ID for the customer request. Used for idempotency validation. You can generate it using UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.  
You can obtain it from **Instance Management** in the left-side navigation pane of the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
parameters.name: account_name
